blocks.text: Lord with a Shofar sound’. And it is said: ‘with trumpets and the Shofar sound cry out before the King, the Lord’. And it was said: ‘Blow the Shofar on the new moon, when the moon is covered, on the day of our festival, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob’. And it was said: ‘Halleluyah, praise God for His holiness, praise Him for the strong firmament. Praise Him for His mighty deeds, praise Him for the abundance of His greatness. Praise Him with the Shofar blast, praise Him with zither and the harp. Praise Him with timbrel and dance, praise Him with string instruments and flutes, praise Him with the clash of cymbals, praise Him with the ring of cymbals. Let all with breath praise the Lord, Halleluyah. And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘all inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth, when the banner is raised on the mountain shall you see and when the Shofar is blown shall you hear’. And it was said: ‘And on that day the great Shofar will be blown and the wanderers in the land of Assyria and the banished in the land of Egypt shall come and prostrate themselves to the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem’. And it was said: ‘And the Lord will appear to them and His arrow shall go forth like lightning and the Lord God will blow the Shofar and He will walk in the whirlwinds of the south. The Lord of Hosts will protect them’. So mayest Thou protect Thy people Israel with Thy peace.
uncertainties: The print has no closing quote after 'Halleluyah.' I kept it as printed; see source_sic_corr. The line-end hyphen in 'instru-ments' is joined back as 'instruments'.
